REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_APPROVAL.reason: Не определено, является ли это самостоятельным объектом, изображением планеты или представлением об окружающем мире.

rules.authority: This JSON is the dictionary source of truth. Markdown report is derived.

concept_identity.source_resolution: Exact field + normalized source text resolves through source_bindings. Multiple senses may share canonical text and require distinct sense_key values.
concept_identity.unknown_binding: Fail build and require explicit registry migration; never synthesize an ID.

directionality.COLLOQUIAL: informal target resolves to source canonical
directionality.RELATED: bidirectional relevance only; never evidence of factual presence
directionality.SYNONYM: bidirectional only when relation constraints pass

rules.identity_model: RK17 has ENTITY_TYPE PERSON and SPECIES_SUBJECT CAT; only CAT → ANIMAL belongs to the subject hierarchy.
rules.morphology: Separate Search layer; grammatical forms do not create synonym concepts.

morphology_resolutions.semantic_note: First-person user-intent expression of the same football action; the intent phrase remains in the card, but Search resolves it to the action concept.

object_clothing_policy.rule: Wearable attire, accessories and protective wearable equipment are CLOTHING even when the source card placed them in objects. Standalone or hand-held scene items remain OBJECT.

reproducibility.byte_reproducibility_scope: Generated JSON and Markdown outputs, given identical source files and the same generator version; archive container bytes are excluded.

rules.sections: Never derive or mutate sections through semantic edges.
rules.structural_filters: Exact canonical card values only; dictionary expansion is not used in dropdown matching.

style_coverage.instruction: Do not infer style from pixels.
